---
title: A project copy of an embedded extension
author: Test Author
date: 2026-01-01
engine: markdown
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
filters:
  - veil
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The project copy of veil, named in filters, replaces the embedded filter. A deck that does not name the copy in revealjs-plugins too warns once.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="project-veil"', 'class="light-content"']
        - ['id="veil-config"', 'veil-0\.']
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: '\[embedded\] veil: .*Name the copy in both lists\.'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="project-veil"']
        - ['id="veil-config"']
---

The project keeps its own copy of veil under `_extensions/project/veil/`, and names it in `filters`.
Only that copy runs, and the other embedded tools still run.
The deck names the copy in `filters` only, so it warns that the copy is not in `revealjs-plugins`.
